topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: It’s a bit surprising, isn’t it? Finding out that someone who was so much a part of your childhood doesn’t share the same memories. But you know, memories are funny things. They can fade or be reshaped over time, and sometimes, people just carry different versions of the same past. It doesn’t mean those moments weren’t important; it just means they’re seeing things from a different angle now. Maybe you could try sharing some of your favorite memories with them. Sometimes a story or a photo can bring everything rushing back. And even if it doesn’t, it’s a gentle way to reconnect and build new memories together.
